id: title:Piccirello:cap json nesting depth in flags request decoding

review.posthog_relevance: Protects the Rust feature-flag evaluation worker from stack overflow and DoS by rejecting payloads with excessive nesting before invoking the standard JSON5 parser, which has no depth limit and could recurse infinitely.
review.reason: Adds a 128-level nesting depth guard to JSON5 parsing, rejecting deeply nested payloads before the parser recurses. This prevents potential stack overflow and DoS attacks against the Rust feature-flag evaluation worker.
review.uncertainty: While the code change demonstrates a clear defensive mechanism against a known vulnerability class (stack overflow via deep nesting), the complete review cannot independently verify the actual production impact, historical incident avoidance, or the specific configuration of the parser without additional context.
